title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Manual Nucleated Blood Nanobind®
author: Amy Denton

steps.title: Prepare Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Add nucleated blood and PBS to a 1.5 mL Protein LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 10–20 μL of nucleated blood to the tube.
Add 180–190 μL of 1 X PBS to reach a total volume of 200 μL.

steps.title: Add Enzymes
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K and RNase A to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 μL of Proteinase K.
Add 20 μL of RNase A.

steps.title: Initial Mixing and Incubation
steps.instruction: Mix the blood sample and incubate at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Pulse vortex 10 times for 1 second at maximum setting.
Spin in a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Lysis and Heat Incubation
steps.instruction: Add Buffer BL3 and incubate on a heat block.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of Buffer BL3.
Pulse vortex 10 times for 1 second at maximum setting.
Spin in a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds.
Incubate on a heat block at 55 °C at 900 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Incubation Mixing
steps.instruction: Mix the sample and spin briefly.

substeps.instruction: Pulse vortex 3 times for 1 second at maximum setting.
Spin in a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind HMW DNA to the Nanobind disk using isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add a Nanobind disk to the blood sample tube.
Add 350 μL of 100% isopropanol to the blood sample and Nanobind disk.
Inversion mix 5 times.
Place on a rotating mixer at 9 rpm for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Disk Capture and Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Capture the Nanobind disk and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack to capture the disk.
Discard the supernatant with a pipette, avoiding the disk and removing excess liquid from the tube cap.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer CW1
steps.instruction: Wash the disk with Buffer CW1.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL of Buffer CW1.
Remove tube from magnetic rack and inversion mix 4 times.
Place tube back on magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
To ensure disk is captured at the top: place tube in rack separated from magnet, flip rack so lid is on benchtop, add magnet into rack, then flip assembled rack so sample is right side up.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer CW2
steps.instruction: Wash the disk with Buffer CW2 twice.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of Buffer CW2.
Remove tube from magnetic rack and inversion mix 4 times.
Place tube back on magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
To ensure disk is captured at the top: place tube in rack separated from magnet, flip rack so lid is on benchtop, add magnet into rack, then flip assembled rack so sample is right side up.
Repeat this process for a total of two Buffer CW2 washes.

steps.title: Remove Residual Buffer
steps.instruction: Ensure all residual buffer is removed from the tube.

substeps.instruction: Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds, then place back on the magnetic rack.
Remove any residual buffer; if the disk blocks access, gently push it towards the magnet with the pipette tip.
Repeat the spin and removal process to ensure no residual buffer remains.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the HMW DNA from the Nanobind disk.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample from magnetic rack.
Add 200 μL of Buffer EB directly onto the Nanobind disk.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Eluate Transfer and Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate and recover remaining DNA from the disk.

substeps.instruction: Transfer eluate to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube using a standard p200 pipette and 200 μL tip; repeat until all eluate is transferred.
Spin the tube containing the Nanobind disk at 10,000 × g for 15 seconds.
Combine any additional liquid from the disk with the transferred eluate.
If visible DNA remains on the disk, repeat the centrifuge spin for a total of 2 spins.
Pipette mix the eluate 10 times with a standard p200 pipette and 200 μL tip to homogenize and disrupt viscous regions.
Allow eluate to rest overnight at room temperature to solubilize.
Following the overnight rest, pipette mix 10 times with a standard p200 pipette and 200 μL tip.
Perform required QC.
Store the DNA at 4 °C.
